comments.author: Tiltushkin
comments.body_html:
You need to open Tiltushkin-AllAmmo/data/assort.json In this file you can find all trader items. To find item you need you can use some mods, like give-ui or SPT-aki profile editor. Or you can use https://db.sp-tarkov.com/search. You need this to find correct item ID. After you find it, you need to find it in assort.json (key: “_tpl”). After that you need to check “_id” key and find it in “barter_scheme”. After you find it in barter_scheme, you can change “count” key. Count -> price for 1 item, _tpl -> money id trader sells for.

This is what the matryoshka doll looks like. Good luck!

comments.author: Tiltushkin
comments.body_html:
Actually, I just tried creating a new profile, adding trader version 1.2.0 to it, and then using trader version 1.3.0 in the same profile. At least, everything works for me.

SPT stores information about traders in the player’s JSON (path: SPT/user/profiles), which also contains the trader’s unique ID. In the latest 1.3.0 update, the trader ID was changed (to prevent possible mod conflicts). As stated in the message, you can set the values “removeModItemsFromProfile” and “removeInvalidTradersFromProfile” to true (the path is also specified in the message, SPT\SPT_Data\configs\core.json). After these changes, SPT will automatically remove the old ID from your profile.

I apologize for the inconvenience, but I had to do this.

And remember, always make a backup of your profile before making any changes, just in case
